summary: This class models the Devices MFE (Micro Frontend) page for HP Smart application testing. It extends SmartFlow base class and provides comprehensive test automation methods for device management UI. The class is organized into two main sections: VERIFICATION FLOWS for element presence validation and ACTION FLOWS for user interactions. Notable patterns include: (1) Extensive use of driver.wait_for_object() for synchronization, (2) Configurable timeout and exception handling parameters, (3) JavaScript executor for clicking hidden elements, (4) Multi-screen What's New popup flow verification, (5) Support for alpha testing with dummy printer devices. The class demonstrates enterprise-level page object model implementation with clear separation of verification and action methods, making it suitable for robust end-to-end testing of device management features.
